intended_purpose: deterministic computational research infrastructure for source-informed or hypothetical IgM structural models

core_invariants.name: Perfect Mathematics Does Not Equal Perfect Biological Reality
core_invariants.statement: Mathematical exactness, deterministic execution, numerical convergence, reproducibility, CPU/GPU agreement, or accelerator performance do not by themselves establish biological validity or clinical validity.

core_invariants.name: Representation Is Not Ontology
core_invariants.statement: Geometry, tensor, graph, vortex-inspired, or other mathematical representations are computational parameterizations and must not be presented as literal biological ontology without independent evidence.

core_invariants.name: Unknown Beats Plausible Invention
core_invariants.statement: Unsupported biological values remain unknown or explicitly assumed and must not be silently invented or promoted to evidence.

core_invariants.name: Runtime Success Is Not Clinical Evidence
core_invariants.statement: Passing tests, residual gates, reproducibility checks, receipts, or benchmarks do not establish diagnosis, prognosis, treatment, monitoring, or clinical validation.

core_invariants.name: A Multidimensional Array Is Not Automatically a Tensor
core_invariants.statement: Numerical arrays must not be called tensors unless transformation semantics or another mathematically valid tensor definition is explicitly declared.

core_invariants.name: Coordinate Presentation Must Not Alter Coordinate-Invariant Observables
core_invariants.statement: Rigid changes of presentation coordinates may change displayed coordinates but must preserve declared coordinate-invariant observables such as pairwise Euclidean distances.

core_invariants.name: Graph Representation Must Match Declared Relationship Semantics
core_invariants.statement: Direction, weight, multiplicity, bipartite structure, hyperedges, and relationship types require explicit model semantics rather than visual or categorical assumptions.

core_invariants.name: Topology Is Measured or Sourced, Never Assumed
core_invariants.statement: Properties such as scale-free, small-world, hub, motif, centrality, or community interpretation must be measured or sourced and must not be inferred merely because a model is biological.

core_invariants.name: Visualization Layout Must Not Alter Model Semantics
core_invariants.statement: Changing assembly, array, graph, fabric, cyclic, camera, filter, or layout presentation must not mutate canonical model identity or scientific semantics.

core_invariants.name: Visual Proximity Does Not Imply Biological Proximity
core_invariants.statement: Screen-space adjacency, row order, force-layout placement, or any other visual closeness is presentation only unless a model profile explicitly defines and supports a corresponding biological relation.
